rule: No waiver, no claim inflation, no simulation counted as proof, no unsafe shortcut.
globalInvariants: no direct consequential write path outside Typed Action Gateway
no actor or model may grant or expand its own authority
unknown or contradictory evidence reduces autonomy
executor and verifier are distinct principals
tenant isolation enforced at read, action, evidence and verification layers
all consequential actions are idempotent or reconciled before retry
all reversible actions have tested rollback/compensation
no resolved status without verified postconditions
simulation/shadow results never count as operational proof
predicted value never counts as realised value
learning is proposal-only until independently promoted
requiredProofPerDomain: exact source SHA and built-asset provenance
bounded consequential action or explicit safe abstention
regression generated from verified failure or outcome

mayClaimFullyT9OnlyIf: every domain has reached every promotion ladder stage
all mandatory cross-domain scenarios pass on exact candidate
all proof receipts bind to the same immutable release identity
independent promotion has no unresolved critical finding
mustNotClaimIfAny: a domain is missing a promotion stage
evidence comes only from unit tests or simulation
tenant or payroll safety relies on convention rather than enforcement
external-system behaviour is asserted without evidence
realised financial outcome is inferred rather than reconciled
